sections.title: Ballet Positions
sections.passage: In 1661, King Louis XIV of France founded a Royal Academy of Dancing. The Academy devised rules for the correct ballet steps, based on five main positions of the feet. The positions were planned to give a balance to any position of the body. To this day there have been only a few minor changes made to these positions.

responses.prompt: Why do you think that, since 1661, there have been so few changes made to these positions?
responses.response: because louis the king and he knows best

questionScores.rationale: Attributes the lack of change only to the king's authority rather than to the positions being well-designed/effective for body balance, as stated in the passage.
